steps.en: Authorize root deployment on supported Linux and review the official native installer
steps.zh: 授权受支持 Linux 的高权限部署，审阅官方安装器

steps.en: Install the verified bundle and start the panel, leaving the unconfigured kernel stopped
steps.zh: 安装校验后的整包并启动面板，未配置内核保持停止

steps.en: Set the LAN panel password; import your subscription and choose DNS and routing rules
steps.zh: 设置面板密码，导入订阅并配置域名解析与分流

steps.en: Start the kernel in the panel; point one test device's gateway and DNS at this host
steps.zh: 在面板启动内核，让一台终端的网关与域名解析指向它

steps.en: Apply the selected split-routing rules to that device's connections
steps.zh: 对该终端连接应用所选分流规则

value.en: Manage gateway subscriptions, destination rules and DNS in one panel instead of hand-editing each config
value.zh: 在一个面板管理网关订阅、目标规则和 DNS，不逐份手写配置
